blocks.text: Madina Shaik is a tech expert, Real Estate Investor, and chief innovator behind CompQsoft. He brings expertise from 30 years of consulting on system integration, implementation, requirements analysis, and more.

After finishing his Master’s degree in 1991, Madina applied his expertise to help organizations use technology to better deliver on their business objectives. This is the main challenge he wanted to take on for ComQsoft: To upgrade organizations for the Year 2000 challenge by implementing ERP solutions like SAP and IBM. In the course of growing CompQsoft, Madina amassed skills in information technology areas and related disciplines. Under his leadership, CompQsoft has established multiple, long-term partnerships with leading Federal government contractors. In addition, CompQsoft also count the US Army, US Air Force, US Navy, GSA, and the State of TX as its partners.

Sachin has over 20+ years of experience building financial strategies and managing projects, 12 years of which were directed towards growing CompQsoft. He oversees financial operations, which include Cost Management and financial statements.

Beyond meeting revenue goals and ensuring stable cash flow, Sachin provides insights on improving profitability and maximizing ROI. He establishes financial control and processes that push for growth with accurate and timely insights.

This CFO’s record is only outdone by his 19-year partnership with his wife. He considers her and their two lovely children his biggest blessings. Sachin holds a master’s degree in finance. He is a great conversationalist and is a friendly soul towards everyone.

Thomas is a seasoned operations executive with proven expertise in executing and building businesses across the Defense and Intelligence communities, including the Navy, Air Force, Army, DISA, DLA, DFAS, COCOMs, and DIA.

He is a “go-to” professional for must-fix/turnaround and realignment situations. A trained engineer, Thomas possesses solid technological acumen sharpened by increasingly complex engineering endeavors. He consistently creates a vision for growth by aligning strategy and business models to organizational goals and, in the process, increasing CompQsoft’s top and bottom-line growth.
Qamer is a seasoned IT professional with over 17+ years of experience servicing both the Commercial and Federal sectors.
At CompQsoft, he heads the development, implementation, and maintenance of operational standards and procedures.

Qamer and his team are responsible for supporting all systems across CompQsoft. In his downtime, Qamer enjoys spending time with his family on outdoor excursions and traveling to new destinations. He also enjoys reading and swimming.
Christen brings over 17+ years of human resources (HR) experience in large and mid-size organizations.
At CompQsoft, she leads the human capital lifecycle, including talent acquisition, human resources, employee engagement, change management, and strategic planning.

Christen specialized in Business Management at Liberty University. She lives in a log home along the Shenandoah River in the Blue Ridge Mountains of Virginia with her husband and two children. She enjoys it so much that she says, “It feels like having a year-round vacation!”
